fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingBrands.cy.js#CategoryPages - CategoryListingBrands [tataBrand] [en] — Tata Trucks TC-TBR-02: Check Truck Price lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tata Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-TBR-02
**Title:** Check Truck Price lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Tata Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Tata Trucks page, open Check Truck Price, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Tata Trucks page
2. Click a truck card's "Check Truck Price" button to open its lead form
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
